problem_statement: Commit SHA role delineation and runtime build provenance reconciliation.
root_cause: Artifact generation script executed before Git commit creation. Because a Git commit hash is a cryptographic digest of its tree, parents, author, and timestamp, a committed file cannot contain its own future SHA without a self-referential paradox. In Sprint 16 initial run, the script fell back to HEAD, which was Sprint 15 base.

base_commit_sha.role: Sprint 15 verified delivery commit and ancestral root of Sprint 16.

feature_commit_sha.role: Sprint 16 code and feature freeze. Contains Research Workbench V5, Pattern Discovery, 32 reports, and API.

staging_build_commit_sha.role: Exact Git revision from which the running Coolify staging Docker container (86881ba01b3e) was built at 2026-10-26T09:17:00Z.

final_commit_sha.role: Sprint 16 delivery artifacts and generated reports commit.

recovery_commit_sha.role: Sprint 16 closure recovery, epistemic attestation, and manifest contract documentation commit.

remediation_protocol.stage_1_feature_freeze: Code and tests committed to produce verified feature_commit_sha.
remediation_protocol.stage_2_manifest_generation: Delivery manifest generated referencing the established feature_commit_sha.
remediation_protocol.stage_3_closure_verification: Post-commit recovery and closure artifacts record both feature, final, and recovery SHAs.

staging_container_operational.exclusion_rationale: High-frequency 1m tick aggregates excluded from container image to optimize image size and startup latency.
